purpose: Proposed acceptance scenario definitions; no execution or certification is implied.

cases.scenario: Approve actual entity, executed authority, county/model, launch and benefit/delegation scope.
expectedEvidence: Versioned signed scope and authority inventory
Named accountable owners and accepted exclusions

cases.scenario: Route a CA paid claim through the contracted encounter partner and final receiver.
Replay duplicates, partial reads, final rejections, corrections, voids and replacements.
Reconcile source records to final accepted encounters and applicable QMED 2.0 measures.
Import actual medical MEDS/834/HCO layouts and schedules with duplicate/out-of-order records.
expectedEvidence: Approved partner layouts and control totals

cases.scenario: Apply retroactive enrollment, county/aid changes, reinstatement and termination.
expectedEvidence: Reconciled PCP, claims and capitation effects

cases.scenario: Fulfill actual plan-type notices with language/format, retry and returned-mail cases.
Process PA appeal/hearing, representation, continued benefits and reversals.
expectedEvidence: External handoff and reversal implementation evidence

cases.scenario: Replay settlement, return, reversal and reissue with expected dollar results.
Run two agreed representative close simulations; proposed plan gate, not a prescribed statutory count.
expectedEvidence: Opening balances and expected premium/capitation/claims entries

cases.scenario: Verify authorized enrollment sources by service location, program and effective date, including unavailable/stale inputs.
Accept network 274 and published directory independently of enrollment verification.
Propagate effective-dated capitation amendments with retry and retroactive adjustments.
Validate current-day competing assignments on the selected cloud transaction topology.
expectedEvidence: One-slot race, same-member retry and rollback outcomes
No silent fallback on unsupported Mongo

cases.scenario: Accept future and retroactive PCP assignment workflows or an explicitly approved operating handoff.
expectedEvidence: Current date guard retained until replacement is accepted

cases.scenario: Exercise imports, direct coverage changes, reactivations and reconciliation against panel policy.
expectedEvidence: Inventory of all roster writers and fences
No unexplained oversubscription; durable reconciliation ownership

cases.scenario: Resolve coverage, PA requirements and clinical criteria using an approved California catalog.
expectedEvidence: Unknown distinguished from no authorization required

cases.scenario: Validate all-channel receipt, urgency, tighter rules and lawful extensions.
Replay agreed peak workload, tenant isolation, failover and restore on selected Azure/GCP deployment.
Reconcile PA channels/appeal levels to annual draft, correction and immutable approved freeze.
expectedEvidence: Source completeness, plan mapping and legitimate extension provenance
Approved public output; draft is not approval

cases.scenario: Accept applicable DHCS quarterly/annual template and QIC review deliverables.
expectedEvidence: Reconciled metrics and quality review/action evidence
Separate acceptance from public annual webpage

cases.scenario: Validate applicable 2026 US Core 6.1.0/SMART 2.0 or permitted newer specifications against the live server.
expectedEvidence: Approved version/applicability map and USCDI scope

cases.scenario: Accept required Patient/Provider/P2P data, clinical documents and bulk where applicable.
expectedEvidence: Scoped jobs, authorized files and recovery where required

cases.scenario: Produce annual distinct-member and repeat-use Patient Access counts.
expectedEvidence: Member deduplication and expected annual counts
Accepted reporting and accessible education/consent-rights materials

cases.scenario: Accept the plan-approved replacement-card rule when a committed PCP change alters printed card content.
expectedEvidence: Durable post-commit trigger covering every supported assignment entry point
Assignment-based duplicate suppression and effective-date-aware card bindings
Separate digital issuance and print/mail acceptance, failure and reconciliation evidence
No replacement for a rejected assignment; retry does not order duplicates
